character.name: Master Sergeant Clayton Dex
character.description: Master Sergeant Dex is a legend among the 180th. The most senior Pararescue Jumper in the regiment, he's the only one with a one-hun-dred-percent success rate. He doesn't speak about his past before the 180th; all that is known is that he arrived at a 180th base one day with a lot of combat augmentations and trauma surgeon credentials, and he volunteered for rescue duty. Master Sergeant Dex usually doesn't usually speak unless giving or replying to orders. When he does speak, everyone listens. During operations, he is capable of handling any combat or medical situation and will go to extreme lengths to complete his objective. Despite his skills, Dex is starting to show his forty-seven years, and General von Braun has repeatedly requested that he take an instructor's position. Every time he respectfully replies "I'll take it under consideration, ma'am."
